purpose: One finite execution counterfactual after observing HIFI terminal residual: keep the identical original entry, size, fees, risk and exit-submission clock; allow outstanding exits to consume the already-known pre-cessation buffer. Do not mistake a one-bar terminal protocol for proven impossibility of exit.
rule: Request both legs at original case deadline minus5min, exactly as baseline. Hard replay end is the earliest actually known spot/perpetual market cessation minus5min. Stop before the last possible market bar rather than assume a fill at or after cessation. Use only clauses visible at original decision. No new entries, no future funding used in selection, no fee or risk optimization.
engine_change: Only accept explicit signal exit_reason for scheduled buffer; all pricing, fee, funding, wallet and risk logic remains unchanged. Original frozen engine and all baseline outputs stay intact.
required_checks: new source windows independently checked against same raw CSV and exact funding responses
baseline and buffer cash/NAV prefix identical through original cutoff
entry and full prefix source values unchanged
residual versus actual delayed fills explicitly reported
internal audit and actual new-process recovery
interpretation: This tests execution-window truncation in two selected cases, not strategy profitability, population capacity, new independent trials or unseen validation. Remaining one-leg risk and slippage during unwind must be retained.
